comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 is 1 only when a comment names a specific external program or location, such as a named country, city or policy program. A named location counts even if it is not a case or example. Feature 1 is 1 when a comment cites a particular concrete case, instance, person, organization, event or situation as support. It does not require a named program or location, and it counts persons and events. Neither is a subtype of the other: a named country mention is not necessarily a localized example, and a personal anecdote or named person is not a program or location. The OC_comments source and the 1/0/null rules match, but the eligibility criteria differ materially.
